name: toggles
title: Rules with switches
shows: A titled list of four rules, each a label, a grey line and a switch; one switch flips at a time (the changed row takes the accent) and the count follows.
edit: Rows are HTML (is-on on the switches that are on). The count keeps its words; only its first figure follows.
loop: about 2.6 s a cycle: two switches flip in turn and the count follows; back to the page's state every six; the finished picture holds for at most 15% of the cycle; restarts when the pointer enters its card
place: at-corner or at-right (32px in, 56px down), cut by the bottom edge with .stage--fade-b
